sources.title: What is Embedding? - Embeddings in Machine Learning Explained - AWS
sources.snippet: Embeddings are numerical representations of real-world objects that machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) systems use to understand complex knowledge domains like humans do. As an example, computing algorithms understand that the difference between 2 and 3 is 1, indicating a close relationship between 2 and 3 as compared to 2 and 100.
